product_metadata.title: ProductWorks 24-Inch Peanuts Charlie Brown Musical Christmas Tree with Linus Blanket
features: OFFICIALLY LICENSED: Officially licensed Peanuts decoration
Fan favorite: a great gift for fans of the beloved 1965 animated Christmas Special
Durability: Constructed of wood, metal, and PVC. Includes Classic red Christmas bulb ornament and Linus's blue blanket. Plays the classic peanut theme song, 2 AAA batteries included
description: Good grief! Now you can have your own Charlie brown Christmas with this official 24" Replica of the famous holiday tree from the 1965 animated Charlie brown Christmas Special. The Peanuts Charlie Brown musical Christmas tree with Linus blanket Makes a great gift for fans of the classic comic strip & animated Franchise. Decorated with the traditional red ornament & Linus's blue blanket, This charming little tree will spruce up your home with holiday cheer & maybe even teach the true spirit of Christmas. An attached music chip heightens the mood By playing the timeless "Linus & Lucy" Peanuts Theme song, while the wooden base features The official peanuts logo to prove its authenticity. Specially designed, this tree will provide good Tidings & good humor for many holidays to come. Not water needed, just add love!
